description: This file defines functions for managing channel tools and message actions within a chat or messaging system, including retrieving plugin data, listing supported actions, and resolving tool hints and capabilities.

methods.name: getChannelAgentToolMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with a specific channel agent tool.

methods.name: copyChannelAgentToolMeta
methods.description: Copies metadata from one channel agent tool to another.

methods.name: listChannelSupportedActions
methods.description: Returns supported message actions for a specific channel based on provided parameters.

methods.name: listAllChannelSupportedActions
methods.description: Returns all supported message actions across all configured channels.

methods.name: listChannelAgentTools
methods.description: Aggregates and returns channel-owned agent tools.

methods.name: resolveChannelMessageToolHints
methods.description: Resolves message tool hints for a specific channel.

methods.name: resolveChannelMessageToolCapabilities
methods.description: Resolves message tool capabilities for a specific channel.

methods.name: resolveChannelReactionGuidance
methods.description: Provides reaction guidance for a channel, including level and label.
